papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The post-COVID-19 resurgence of pertussis has raised concerns regarding shifts in circulating Bordetella pertussis populations and increasing macrolide resistance. This study aims to characterize the population dynamics and clinically relevant genomic changes of B. pertussis in China and globally, and to develop a rapid visual assay for detecting the macrolide resistance-associated 23S rRNA A2047G mutation. METHODS: In this cross-sectional genomic epidemiology study, 22 recent clinical isolates were sequenced and analyzed with 7322 publicly available B. pertussis genomes. Global population structure was assessed using 7344 genomes, and Bayesian phylodynamic analysis was performed on 1054 temporally informative Chinese genomes selected from 1292 isolates collected during 1951-2024. We designed and optimized an allele-specific loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) assay incorporating a 3'-terminal artificial mismatch and a neutral red indicator for detection of the macrolide resistance-associated 23S rRNA A2047G mutation. Its analytical sensitivity and specificity were evaluated alongside quantitative PCR (qPCR) using serially diluted plasmids and 39 contrived DNA samples. RESULTS: The macrolide resistance of B. pertussis in China, defined by the 23S rRNA A2047G mutation, reached 98.9% (88/89; 95% CI 93.9-100) among available genomes in 2024, concurrent with the rapid clonal expansion of the ptxP3-MT28 sub-lineage. Among the available Chinese isolates, the proportion of predicted Prn-deficient strains increased to 31.46% in 2024, with 12 distinct prn inactivation mechanisms, predominantly IS481-mediated insertions. The optimized LAMP assay differentiated mutant and wild-type alleles within 50 min at 65°C, with a neutral red visual limit of detection (LOD) of 10 copies/μL, compared with 100 copies/μL for qPCR. The results of LAMP-based differentiation were consistent with those obtained by qPCR for all 39 contrived samples. CONCLUSIONS: B. pertussis populations have undergone marked genomic shifts characterized by antigenic variation and macrolide resistance, although the evolutionary drivers underlying these temporal and genomic patterns remain to be determined. The visual LAMP assay provides a proof-of-concept analytical evidence for rapid A2047G allele discrimination and may have future point-of-care potential following validation with prospective clinical respiratory specimens. These findings support continued genomic surveillance and further evaluation of vaccine antigen matching and antimicrobial resistance.

papers.abstract_en: Lung transplantation (LTx) remains the only curative option for patients with end-stage pulmonary diseases. However, long-term outcomes are compromised by ischemia-reperfusion injury (IRI), a major contributor to primary graft dysfunction and chronic lung allograft impairment. Current pharmacological and technological strategies provide only partial protection, highlighting the need for novel therapeutic approaches. In this study, we investigated the therapeutic potential of extracellular vesicles derived from human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSC-EV) in a two-dimensional (2D) in vitro model of pulmonary IRI using A549 lung epithelial cells. To better recapitulate the in vivo airway microenvironment, we also employed a human airway organoid (hAO) model. Proteomic analysis of hiPSC-EV identified 1,698 proteins enriched in pathways relevant to apoptosis regulation, oxidative stress responses, and inflammatory signaling. In the 2D IRI model, the administration of hiPSC-EV during reperfusion significantly improved cell viability, reduced lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release, attenuated reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation, and decreased apoptosis and necrosis. Furthermore, hiPSC-EV downregulated pro-inflammatory mediators (NFkB1, TNFα, IL1β, IL8, MCP1) while upregulating anti-inflammatory and anti-apoptotic key factors (IL1RA, BCL2). In the 3D model, hiPSC-EV administration preserved organoid structure and viability under IRI conditions, attenuated transcriptional and protein-level expression of pro-inflammatory and oxidative stress markers (IL1β, IL8, HMGB1, HMOX1), and enhanced anti-inflammatory (IL10) and cytoprotective (HSP27, HSP70) responses. Immunofluorescence further revealed that hiPSC-EV reduced activation of apoptotic and pyroptotic pathways. Moreover, intravenous administration of hiPSC-EV in mice showed no adverse safety signals, including tumorigenicity. Together, these findings demonstrate that hiPSC-EV exert broad cytoprotective effects in pulmonary IRI through coordinated regulation of inflammation, oxidative stress, and cell death. Their scalability, reproducibility, and favorable safety profile underscore their promise as innovative cell-free therapeutics to improve outcomes in LTx.

papers.abstract_en: Accurate monitoring of volatile biogenic amines is critical for early food spoilage warning yet hindered by the low adsorption and small intrinsic Raman cross sections of gaseous molecules. Herein, we constructed a surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) hydrogel platform based on Au nanostars@4-mercaptobenzaldehyde@ZIF-8 (AuNSs@4-MBA@ZIF-8) to monitor cadaverine and putrescine. This rationally designed hierarchical core-shell architecture is further integrated into a flexible hydrogel network. This architecture synergizes metal-organic framework (MOF)-assisted molecular sieving and nanoenrichment with the Schiff base-mediated transformation of weakly scattering amines into highly Raman-active conjugated molecules. Simultaneously, the 4-MBA reporter serves as a built-in internal standard for reliable ratiometric calibration. Benefiting from this quadruple "sieving-enrichment-capturing-calibration" strategy, the sensor exhibits excellent detection performance for both liquid and gaseous amines, achieving broad dynamic ranges spanning 5 orders of magnitude. In addition, it was successfully applied to the in situ monitoring of real meat spoilage via direct conformal contact, demonstrating its excellent promise for detecting trace volatile markers in complex environments for food safety.

papers.abstract_en: Palladium (Pd)-based sensitizers are widely employed to boost the hydrogen (H2) sensing properties of metal oxide semiconductor (MOS)-based sensors owing to their outstanding catalytic activity. However, the generation of palladium hydride (PdHx) induces strong electron scattering, causing an abnormal response inversion that compromises detection reliability. Herein, we proposed an electronic structure engineering induced by alloying to suppress response inversion. Metal-organic-framework-derived In2O3 hollow microtubes decorated with PdPt alloy were assembled into sensor devices and evaluated for H2 detection. The sensor with 0.5 wt.% PdPt loading achieves the optimal performance, with high sensitivity (9.5 to 100 ppm H2), ultrafast response/recovery kinetics (3 s/4 s), and a limit of detection as low as 500 ppb. Notably, the PdPt/In2O3 sensor completely eliminates abnormal response inversion in contrast to the Pd/In2O3 sensor. Density functional theory calculations reveal that the modification of the PdPt alloy preserves high catalytic activity toward H2 while effectively hindering the diffusion of H atoms into the Pd bulk, thereby ensuring sensitive and reliable sensing. Furthermore, the PdPt/In2O3 sensor array integrated with machine learning algorithms demonstrates reliable discrimination of H2 from interfering gases, highlighting its potential for practical gas monitoring. This study provides a rational electronic structure engineering strategy to suppress PdHx-induced response inversion, providing a clear experimental and theoretical foundation for the development of reliable H2 sensors.

papers.abstract_en: Heterojunctions of graphene and MOFs are highly desired for optoelectronic sensing analysis, yet disordered MOF growth severely restricts interfacial charge transfer and sensing performance. Herein, we report a solution-phase synthesis by taking advantage of the Marangoni effect to achieve the oriented growth of a porphyrin-based MOF on laser-induced graphene (LIG), yielding a LIG-MOF heterojunction with vertically aligned spike arrays. The intimate heterointerface enables ordered 3D electron transport and generates an interfacial electric field (IEF) to boost photoelectrochemical (PEC) properties, offering an enlarged carrier density by 3.0 × 105-fold compared with LIG. For surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS), a selectively enhanced Raman signal of the MOF by methylene blue (MB) is observed on LIG-MOF, uncovering a competitive charge transfer mechanism. In LIG-MOF, IEF properly directs electrons from LIG to the MOF while blocking electron injection into MB; photoexcited electrons from MB transfer stepwise to the MOF, enhancing its Raman signal. Consequently, a PEC-SERS biosensing chip is developed with LIG-MOF via aptamer-gated controlled MB absorption. The biosensing chip can simultaneously generate in situ PEC and SERS responses under 532 nm laser excitation via the LIG-MOF heterojunction for accurate and sensitive detection of patulin. This work provides a feasible interfacial-engineering strategy for the design and fabrication of high-performance dual-mode biosensors for advanced analytical sensing.

papers.abstract_en: Realizing high pressure sensitivity in intrinsically soft sensors is a critical challenge for precise human-machine interfaces (HMI), as achieving high sensitivity while maintaining the intrinsic flexibility and wearability of fully soft materials remains a significant challenge. Herein, we report a fully-soft, protrusion-integrated smart insole for comfortable, high-fidelity dynamic motion tracking. By utilizing protrusions as stress concentrators, the system overcomes silicone's incompressibility, inducing rapid geometric collapse of underlying liquid metal microchannels. Notably, parametric optimization of the protrusion geometry reduced the critical detection threshold (Fc) down to as low as 1 N. This significant reduction effectively minimizes the sensing dead zone, ensuring high sensitivity even in the low-pressure regime. Fabricated via a hybrid process of direct ink writing and monolithic molding, the sensor ensures a seamless interface and structural integrity without rigid inclusions. The wireless system collects stable signals at 60 Hz, and when integrated with a 1D-CNN, achieved a high classification accuracy of 96.62% in a mixed-subject scenario. Furthermore, the system demonstrated robust generalization with an accuracy of 79.4% in inter-participant tests, and superior personalized performance with over 99% accuracy in intra-participant tasks.

papers.abstract_en: Translating molecular-scale chemical interactions into intuitive and information-rich visual representations remains a central challenge in chemical sensing. Liquid crystals (LCs) provide a stimulus-responsive optical medium for chemical-to-optical transduction; however, existing approaches primarily rely on predefined optical responses rather than programmable representations of multiple chemical concentrations. Here, we introduce a laser-projection-programmed LC platform that extends established LC visual sensing toward programmable, multilevel concentration-to-symbol encoding. By integrating near ultraviolet laser-written photoalignment with visible laser readout in a write-read decoupled projection architecture, the LC anchoring configuration and polarization response can be programmed directly through projected optical patterns. Chemically induced changes in LC phase retardation are thereby converted into spatially programmed, naked-eye-readable optical symbols. Using acetone vapor as a model analyte, multiple concentration regimes are programmably encoded into distinct visual symbols, enabling intuitive interpretation of chemical exposure through symbolic visual outputs.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Fascial closure after a midline laparotomy (ML) is a crucial step to avoid incisional hernia. This meta-analysis aimed to compare short- and long-term outcomes, including incisional hernia, of the small-bite versus large-bite closure techniques in ML. METHODS: A PRISMA-compliant systematic review of RCTs comparing small-bite (5-mm bites/spacing) and large-bite (10-mm bites/spacing) techniques in ML closure was conducted. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and Cochrane Central were searched from inception through April 2026 for eligible RCTs. The primary outcome was incisional hernia. Secondary outcomes included total complications, surgical-site infection (SSI), seroma, fascial dehiscence, closure time, and pain. Pairwise meta-analyses and trial sequential analyses (TSA) were performed. RESULTS: Ten unique RCTs reported in 12 publications (2617 patients) were included. Among the five studies using standardized clinical and imaging assessment, small-bite closure reduced incisional hernia by 43% (risk ratio (RR) of 0.57 (95% c.i. 0.39 to 0.82) (P = 0.003, I2 = 44.1%), compared with an RR of 0.31 (95% c.i. 0.18 to 0.53) (P < 0.001, I2 = 0) when clinical assessment only was used). Across all eligible studies with follow-up >12 months, the pooled RR was 0.48 (95% c.i. 0.33 to 0.70). This benefit persisted on the analysis of studies with ≥24 months of follow-up (RR 0.56 (95% c.i. 0.36 to 0.89)). TSA demonstrated firm evidence for benefit despite not reaching the required information size. Small-bite closure was also associated with reduced SSI (RR 0.72) and total complications (RR 0.76), with no differences in seroma or fascial dehiscence. Closure time was slightly longer with small-bite closure (weighted mean difference 4.82 min), while pain scores were comparable. CONCLUSION: The small-bite technique significantly reduced incisional hernia and postoperative complications after ML, with durable benefit extending beyond 2 years.

papers.abstract_en: The fungal cell wall is a dynamic structure whose composition and integrity are closely coupled to metabolism, morphogenesis, and environmental fitness. Glutamine fructose-6-phosphate amidotransferase (Gfa1), the committed enzyme of the hexosamine biosynthetic pathway, supplies precursors for UDP-N-acetylglucosamine production and cell-wall chitin synthesis. Although Gfa1 is essential for growth and virulence in Aspergillus fumigatus, its role in the cell-wall biology and developmental program of the aflatoxigenic fungus Aspergillus flavus remains unclear. Here, we characterized a gfa1 deletion mutant and a complemented strain of A. flavus. Loss of gfa1 caused glucosamine/N-acetylglucosamine auxotrophy and markedly impaired vegetative growth and conidiation. Despite amino-sugar supplementation, the mutant exhibited increased sensitivity to cell-wall perturbing agents and significant reductions in cell-wall chitin and glucan, indicating disrupted cell-wall homeostasis. Gfa1 deficiency also severely impaired sclerotial formation and increased sensitivity to several environmental stresses. Importantly, the mutant showed markedly reduced colonization of peanut and maize seeds and no detectable aflatoxin B1 accumulation under the conditions tested. Consistent with its broad fitness defects, Δgfa1 displayed strongly attenuated virulence in Galleria mellonella. These findings establish Gfa1-dependent hexosamine metabolism as an important determinant of cell-wall homeostasis and developmental competence in A. flavus and reveal a link between amino-sugar metabolism, fungal surface integrity, sclerotial differentiation, and crop-associated fitness.

papers.abstract_en: Tumor progression and therapeutic failure are classically interpreted through the lenses of genetic evolution and ongoing signaling dynamics. However, increasing evidence suggests that tumors are also shaped by durable imprints of prior microenvironmental exposures. These prior exposures can leave persistent epigenetic and structural imprints that progressively stabilize adaptive cellular states, allowing transient responses to become durable regulatory programs. Chronic inflammation, metabolic stress, therapeutic pressure, and extracellular matrix remodeling induce persistent molecular states across cancer cells and stromal compartments, generating history-dependent phenotypes that influence future biological responses. Building on these observations, we propose that these adaptive processes collectively constitute a distributed tumor microenvironment (TME) memory encoded across cancer cells, fibroblasts, immune cells, endothelial cells, and the extracellular matrix (ECM), rather than representing isolated mechanisms of adaptation. We examine how TME memory contributes to therapy resistance, immune dysfunction, cancer-cell dormancy, minimal residual disease, and tumor recurrence, and discuss the molecular mechanisms underlying memory encoding, persistence, and recall. Finally, we discuss the experimental and clinical strategies required to identify memory-rich tumors, develop biomarkers of historical imprinting, and design memory-aware therapeutic interventions. By integrating diverse forms of adaptive persistence within a unified history-dependent framework, TME memory provides a conceptual foundation for investigating tumor evolution, therapeutic resistance, and future precision oncology strategies.

papers.abstract_en: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) continues to compromise the clinical utility of conventional antibiotics, highlighting the need for innovative adjuvant strategies. Zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnO-NP) have gained attention due to their intrinsic antimicrobial properties and capacity to potentiate antibiotic activity through multimodal mechanisms. This scoping review systematically mapped current evidence on ZnO-NP with antibiotics combinations (ZnO-NP-antibiotic) following the PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Searches in PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science identified 14 eligible studies. To ensure comprehensive coverage of the literature, an additional manual search was conducted using Google Scholar and the reference lists of the included studies, and 10 further articles were identified. In total, 24 articles are included in this scoping review. Most investigations relied on simple physical mixtures (n = 13); while fewer explored conjugation between ZnO-NP-antibiotic (n = 3); encapsulated systems (n = 4); or drug-loaded (n = 4). Better antimicrobial activity was consistently reported across multiple antibiotic classes. Although all studies evaluated planktonic activity, only 10 incorporated biofilm models. Notably, translational maturity remains limited: more than half of the studies (n = 14) did not include toxicity assessment, and safety evaluation was considered based on in vitro cytotoxicity assays (n = 5); in vivo investigations (n = 5) or Hen's Egg Test-Chorioallantoic Membrane (HET-CAM) (n = 1). These findings indicate that ZnO-NP-antibiotic systems remain predominantly in the early stages of development. Future progress will require standardized antibiofilm methodologies, systematic toxicological profiling, pharmacokinetic characterization, and mechanistic validation to establish reproducible structure-activity relationships. Addressing these translational and regulatory challenges will determine whether nanoparticle-mediated synergy can advance beyond a laboratory proof-of-concept toward clinically viable antimicrobial strategies.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Suicide or other intentional self-harm (SSH) represents a critical global public health burden, yet biologically informed targets remain poorly defined due to its complex and incompletely understood etiology. This study aimed to prioritize genetically supported candidate targets for SSH and characterize their biological and translational relevance. METHODS: We developed a multi-omics evidence framework integrating transcriptomic and proteomic Mendelian randomization, colocalization, and sensitivity diagnostics. The primary SSH outcome was from FinnGen R12 (11,538 cases; 488,810 controls). eQTLGen and GTEx were used for transcriptomic analyses, and UKB-PPP and ARIC for proteomic validation. Downstream analyses included functional enrichment, tissue expression profiling, exploratory metabolomic pathway analysis, brain cell-type-specific eQTL analyses, phenome-wide liability scanning, structural modeling with docking, virtual screening and molecular dynamics simulations, and baseline SSH classification in UKB-PPP individual-level proteomic data. RESULTS: Transcriptome-wide MR identified 1,164 FDR-significant genes, of which 55 were retained as Tier 1-4 prioritized candidates after proteomic validation, colocalization, and sensitivity assessment. HSDL2 was the sole Tier 1 candidate, supported by consistent eQTL and pQTL evidence, adequate instrument strength, and colocalization at the HSDL2 locus (PP.H4 = 0.797). Genetically predicted HSDL2 expression was associated with higher SSH risk in eQTLGen (OR = 1.133, 95% CI: 1.076-1.192) and showed directionally consistent protein-level evidence in UKB-PPP (OR = 1.050, 95% CI: 1.005-1.098). Enrichment and metabolomic analyses implicated lipid-, bile acid-, and organelle-related pathways. Brain cell-type-specific analyses suggested neuronal involvement, with consistent excitatory-neuron associations across discovery and validation datasets and additional support for inhibitory neurons in SingleBrain, while oligodendrocyte signals required cautious interpretation. Structural analyses supported a putative HSDL2 ligand-binding pocket, providing hypothesis-generating structural context for the metabolic findings. CONCLUSIONS: HSDL2 was prioritized as a genetically supported and biologically plausible candidate target for SSH, implicating a potential lipid-metabolic and neuronal vulnerability axis. papers.abstract_en: When hearing fails, cochlear implants (CIs) restore auditory perception. Yet, coding of spectral information remains a bottleneck because each electrode broadly activates the auditory nerve. As light can be more conveniently confined in space, optical (o)CIs present an alternative. Here, we combined expression of the potent channelrhodopsin ChReef in spiral ganglion neurons (SGNs) with oCIs comprising 5-10 green LEDs in gerbils. This combination enabled systematic comparison of encoding intensity and spectral information by individual oCI channels to acoustic and electrical stimulation within a translationally feasible energy range. Recordings from the inferior colliculus (ICC) showed that ChReef aligned SGN light sensitivity with LED radiant fluxes: ICC activity had thresholds <200 nJ and reached a maximum equivalent to that achieved with 51 dB SPL pure tones. Multichannel oCIs enabled tonotopically ordered, spectrally distinct stimulation that more closely resembled acoustic stimulation than did electrical stimulation. Some LEDs elicited multiple spectral peaks at higher intensities. Linear discriminant analysis of ICC activity indicated improved channel discriminability for optical over electrical stimulation. In summary, µJ-oCI-stimulation achieves improved spectral resolution over state-of-the-art electrical stimulation.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: In severe uncontrolled asthma, dupilumab has been shown to reduce exacerbations and symptom burden. In other type 2 conditions, the dosing interval has been successfully prolonged while maintaining disease control. OBJECTIVE: Here, we aim to assess if dupilumab dosing intervals can be prolonged in severe asthma while maintaining disease control. METHODS: 24 dupilumab early responders underwent a trial of dosing interval prolongation. CONCLUSION: The majority of dupilumab early responders were able to successfully prolong their dosing interval while maintaining disease control. papers.abstract_en: Non-targeted screening (NTS) coupled with high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS) has revolutionized detection of unknown contaminants of emerging concern (CECs), including pharmaceutical transformation products, novel disinfection byproducts, emerging PFAS variants, and a wide diversity of other organic micropollutants, without reliance on reference standards. This critical review focuses on aquatic matrices (wastewater, surface water, drinking water, and related environmental waters) and examines current trends in LC-HRMS and GC-HRMS workflows, highlighting their complementarity for comprehensive chemical-space coverage in complex environmental matrices. Principal advances include generic sample preparation strategies, advanced data processing tools (MZmine, patRoon, Compound Discoverer), Schymanski et al.-based identification frameworks with recent harmonization efforts, and the integration of suspect-enhanced non-target approaches. Complementary LC/GC workflows, enhanced by ion mobility and multi-dimensional separations, significantly improve feature detection and identification confidence for unknowns. The review further explores the translation of NTS data into risk-assessment frameworks via effect-directed and virtual EDA approaches, as well as selected applications in wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE). Key challenges persist, including high data volume and complexity, false positives/negatives, matrix effects, semi-quantification uncertainty, and limited inter-laboratory reproducibility. Recent harmonization initiatives by the NORMAN network and interlaboratory studies are progressively addressing these gaps through standardized QA/QC and reporting practices. In conclusion, LC/GC-HRMS NTS offers transformative potential for early-risk detection and proactive regulatory decision-making, particularly in the context of expanding EPA PFAS monitoring. Future perspectives emphasize AI-driven automation, multi-omics integration, real-time monitoring platforms, and stronger linkage to policy frameworks. As harmonization and technological advances mature, NTS will shift environmental analysis from reactive targeted monitoring toward predictive, systems-level protection of human and ecological health.

papers.abstract_en: Oropouche virus (OROV) infection has gained increasing public health attention due to the ongoing outbreaks in South and Central America. The World Health Organisation (WHO) lists OROV as a priority pathogen for epidemic and pandemic preparedness. This work aimed to identify and categorise the available evidence on OROV to inform research prioritisation. We conducted a rapid mapping review (search date: up to 5 June 2025) to identify primary studies on OROV and categorised these by area of research, study design, and geographic region using a pre-defined framework. Included studies were displayed in an interactive evidence gap map (EGM) to identify any evidence gaps. In total, 269 primary studies on OROV were included and mapped into the EGM. Of these, the majority of data and findings were reported from South America, Central America and the Caribbean, reflecting the geographical epidemiology of OROV. The majority of studies were observational and descriptive, based on specific outbreaks. Limited evidence was found on vector surveillance, viral pathogenesis, diagnostics and immune correlates of protection. No experimental studies on potential therapeutics or vaccines conducted in humans were identified. The findings from our mapping review and EGM highlight the utility of this methodology to rapidly identify gaps in scientific evidence for emerging or re-emerging pathogens with outbreak potential. The EGM can be used solely, or in conjunction with other prioritisation tools, in order to focus investment and research efforts towards priority topics.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Nearly 10% of sex workers in sub-Saharan Africa live with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV). HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) using tenofovir/emtricitabine (TDF/FTC) has not been studied in this population, possibly due to concerns of hepatitis flares following TDF/FTC cessation. METHODS: Using a microsimulation model of HIV and HBV disease and data from 2016 to 2024, we compared the clinical impact of TDF/FTC as PrEP versus no TDF/FTC among women who sell sex with HBV in Côte d'Ivoire. We incorporated the anti-HBV effects of TDF/FTC and the increased probability of hepatitis flares and HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) loss following TDF/FTC cessation. We estimated input parameters from published literature: HIV incidence (1.9-3.0 per 100 person-years), PrEP adherence (55%), disengagement from PrEP care (4% per month for the first 12 months, then 12.5% per month), hepatitis flare incidence (2.0-4.0 per 100 person-years) and rate of HBsAg loss (1.0 per 100 person-years), which both increase following TDF/FTC cessation. Model outcomes included cumulative HIV incidence, average hepatitis flares, HBsAg loss and survival over 2, 5 and 10 years. We conducted sensitivity analyses varying HIV incidence, PrEP adherence, disengagement from PrEP care and hepatitis flare rate. RESULTS: Compared with no TDF/FTC, TDF/FTC would reduce cumulative HIV incidence: 4.1% versus 5.6% at 2 years and 10.1% versus 12.7% at 5 years. TDF/FTC would result in more hepatitis flares (mean 0.76 vs. 0.19 per person) and more HBsAg loss (8.4% vs. 5.7%) than no TDF/FTC after 5 years. Two- and five-year survival would be similar between the two strategies, and TDF/FTC would improve survival over longer horizons. Improving adherence and reducing disengagement from care would increase clinical benefits. Even with high disengagement from care and high risk of hepatitis flares, TDF/FTC would reduce HIV acquisition and improve overall long-term survival. CONCLUSIONS: Women who sell sex with HBV in Côte d'Ivoire would benefit from TDF/FTC as PrEP to avoid HIV acquisition. The increased risk of hepatitis flares, while challenging to manage in resource-limited settings, would be outweighed by the benefits of HIV prevention. Efforts should be made to scale up PrEP in sex workers, including women with chronic HBV.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Female sex workers (FSWs) in Uganda are disproportionately affected by HIV, with prevalence estimates reaching 37%. Decentralization of pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) delivery, including community-based mechanisms, brings services closer to target populations. We assessed feasibility and acceptability of decentralized oral PrEP refill delivery with HIV self-testing (HIVST) through a drug shop-based model in Kampala, Uganda, among FSWs already using oral PrEP. METHODS: From October 2024 to June 2025, we conducted a single-arm pilot interventional study with 45 FSWs, aged≥18 years, receiving oral PrEP from a government facility for ≥ 1 month before enrolment. Participants were purposively linked to community drug shops convenient to their areas of residence for oral PrEP refills provision after HIVST at 1, 3 and 6 months. Feasibility was assessed by study participation rate, accrual and retention parameters. Structured questions using a 4-point Likert scale were used to collect acceptability data at 3 and 6 months. Persistence was assessed by measuring proportions of participants who continued in care, received HIVST and oral PrEP refills from community drug shops. Descriptive analysis was conducted to summarize feasibility, acceptability and persistence to PrEP refills. RESULTS: A total of 45 FSWs (median age [IQR]: 29 [26-35] years) were enrolled. All participants (100%, 45/45) willingly took up the community drug shop-based PrEP delivery model at baseline. Participant retention was 95.6%, 100% and 95.6% at 1, 3 and 6 months, respectively, which aligned with PrEP refill rates. Over 95% of FSWs at 3 and 6 months visits felt very comfortable and preferred receiving PrEP refills from community drug shops, with 100% of participants acknowledging them as very accessible, offering very private service and comfort to discuss sexual health with attending staff. HIVST convenient usability for drug shop staff possibly contributed to model acceptability. CONCLUSIONS: Community drug shop-based HIVST and oral PrEP refill delivery was feasible, acceptable and demonstrated high persistence with oral PrEP refills among this small FSW cohort in Uganda. These results warrant further research to evaluate the oral PrEP refill decentralization impact of this model when it is scaled up to reach a larger number of FSWs and other population groups.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Rising global temperatures are increasingly recognized as a threat to sleep health. Outdoor workers, who often endure prolonged exposure to outdoor heat, may also be impacted by indoor nighttime temperatures. However, few studies have examined both exposures in this population, and, little is known about potential adaptation to heat in relation to sleep outcomes. METHODS: We conducted an intensive longitudinal study with 13 Spanish outdoor workers over a 3-month summer period, during which sleep outcomes (i.e., total sleep time [TST], sleep efficiency [SE], and subjective sleep quality) were measured daily via an activity monitor and ecological momentary assessments. Temperatures were monitored both indoors and outdoors, using bedroom sensors and weather station data. Linear mixed-effects models were used to quantify the daily associations between heat and sleep. RESULTS: Across the whole summer, each 1 °C increase in outdoor and indoor temperature led respectively to decreases of 2.13 (95% CI: -3.84, -0.42) and 3.18 (95% CI: -5.67, -0.70) minutes in total sleep time (TST); 0.09 (95% CI: -0.17, -0.01) and 0.18 (95% CI: -0.30, -0.07) percentage points in sleep efficiency (SE); and 0.09 (95% CI: -0.14, -0.04) and 0.17 (95% CI: -0.24, -0.09) points in subjective sleep quality. Time-varying analyses revealed that the adverse effects of heat on subjective sleep quality were attenuated in August compared with June and July for similar temperatures. DISCUSSION: We found that both indoor and outdoor temperatures were associated with poorer sleep outcomes during the whole summer, along with preliminary evidence of reduced heat-related effects on subjective sleep quality later in the summer.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Climate change is a major threat to global health, and healthcare is itself a substantial contributor. Choosing the route of drug administration may represent a simple opportunity to reduce environmental impact without compromising care. OBJECTIVE: To quantify and compare the incremental environmental impacts and projected future health losses associated with oral, intravenous (IV), and intramuscular (IM) drug administration. METHODS: We performed a life cycle assessment of route-specific materials and packaging associated with oral and parenteral administration scenarios in the emergency departments of the public hospitals of Marseille, France. The functional unit was administration of 100 mg ketoprofen. The active pharmaceutical ingredient was excluded to isolate the environmental impact attributable to the administration route. Environmental impacts were assessed using ReCiPe 2016 and converted into disability-adjusted life minutes (DALMs). RESULTS: GHG emissions were: 19 g CO₂e for oral administration, 279 g CO₂e for IM injection, 440 and 521 g CO₂e for IV flash and IV syringe pump administration with a pre-existing catheter respectively, and 776 g CO₂e for IV administration requiring catheter placement. Oral administration also had the lowest impact across all 18 midpoint environmental indicators. Projected health losses ranged from 0.13 to 5.59 DALMs, with climate change accounting for 88-92% of the total impact. CONCLUSIONS: When clinically appropriate, prioritizing oral administration and reducing unnecessary IV use may substantially decrease healthcare-related emissions while maintaining quality of care, representing a simple step toward more sustainable healthcare and contributing to health for future generations.

papers.abstract_en: Introduction: Bronchial thermoplasty (BT) reduces airway smooth muscle and may benefit severe asthma, but its role alongside biologics remains unclear. We assessed randomised and real-world evidence on efficacy and safety. Methods: We searched PubMed, Scopus, and Cochrane Library for RCTs and observational studies of BT in adults with severe uncontrolled asthma, analysing them separately. Results: Twenty studies were included (five RCTs, 15 observational). In RCTs, BT improved asthma-related quality of life (AQLQ;MD, 0.69; 95% CI 0.30-1.09), asthma control (ACQ; MD,-0.64; 95%CI, -1.10 to -0.19), and morning peak expiratory flow (MD, 20.62 L/min; 95% CI, 4.92-36.32), but did not improve rescue medication use or symptom-free-days. BT increased the risk of hospitalisation during the treatment period (RR, 3.50; 95%CI, 1.26-9.68), with no significant excess thereafter. Real-world studies showed improvements in AQLQ (MD,1.38; 95%CI, 0.97-1.80), ACQ (MD,-1.24; 95%CI, -1.86 to -0.62), and annualised exacerbation rates (MD, -3.79 exacerbations/patient-year; 95%CI, -6.98 to -0.61). Evidence suggested a possible, inconsistent corticosteroid-sparing effect; data on biologics and long-term safety were limited. Conclusions: BT improved asthma-related quality of life and control, mainly in trials without sham controls, but increased short-term hospitalisation risk. Real-world findings were similar but came from uncontrolled studies. BT is not an established alternative to biologics, but may suit carefully selected patients with severe asthma who cannot use or do not respond to them.

papers.abstract_en: Pulmonary rehabilitation improves symptoms, exercise capacity and quality of life in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), although patients with similar clinical characteristics often show different responses. This review summarizes the biological determinants of rehabilitation responsiveness identified through more than 10 years of translational research. Evidence from longitudinal studies of elderly patients with severe COPD undergoing standardized pulmonary rehabilitation was integrated with clinical, functional, molecular, immunological, cognitive, behavioural and lifestyle data, including long-term follow-up. Baseline DNA damage was markedly increased and further rose during rehabilitation (19.6 ± 7.3% vs. 21.8 ± 7.2% tail intensity) despite significant functional improvement. FKBP5 rs4713916 was the only genetic variant associated with better rehabilitation outcomes. Daily vegetable intake independently predicted treatment success, whereas smoking was associated with oxidative DNA damage, immune alterations and higher Torque Teno Virus (TTV) load. TTV ≥ 4 log10 copies/mL was associated with increased regulatory T cells, reduced α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptor expression (31% vs. 52%; p = 0.023) and shorter 5-year survival (609 ± 160 vs. 937 ± 94 days; p = 0.017). Active Coping, Planning and Self-Distraction were the behavioural strategies most strongly associated with rehabilitation response. Cognitive impairment and obesity-related immune regulation further contributed to patient heterogeneity. These observations suggest that rehabilitation responsiveness reflects the interaction of genomic, immune, behavioural and lifestyle factors. Their integration may improve patient stratification and support the development of precision pulmonary rehabilitation.

papers.abstract_en: Background: We recently established that bendopnoea (breathlessness upon bending forward) is common with pleural effusion; however, it has never been reported or investigated in patients with pneumothorax. This exploratory study investigated the prevalence and clinical relevance of bendopnoea in pneumothorax. Methods: Patients with pneumothorax of any aetiology or size were eligible. The presence of bendopnoea and time-to-bendopnoea was measured by bending the patient forward for 60 s and was assessed at baseline and post lung re-expansion. Results: Fifty patients (median age 48 years; 78% male) with primary spontaneous (48%), secondary spontaneous (24%) or iatrogenic (28%) pneumothorax were included. Pneumothorax size ranged from 7 to 99% of the hemithorax on chest radiographs. Most patients (74%) received conservative management. On a questionnaire, 48% (24/50) patients reported they experienced bendopnoea which "impacted daily life". When bent forward, 32% (16/50) developed bendopnoea within 60 s. Patients with bendopnoea reported more breathlessness than those without bendopnoea on a 100 mm Visual Analogue Scale (VAS): median 46 [Q1-Q3 = 25-54] vs. 12 [3-32] mm, respectively, p = 0.0089; median difference -23 mm (95% CI -35 to -6). Those with bendopnoea showed a signal with worse chest pain on a 100 mm VAS for pain: median 28 [13-48] vs. 10 [2-42] mm, p = 0.0528; median difference -15 mm (95% CI -27 to 0). Shorter time-to-bendopnoea (i.e., worse bendopnoea) correlated with worse breathlessness (rs = -0.38, 95% CI -0.6 to -0.1; p = 0.0072) and more severe chest pain (rs = -0.29, 95% CI -0.5 to -0.007; p = 0.039). Conclusions: Bendopnoea can occur with pneumothorax, correlates with breathlessness and demonstrates a signal with worse chest pain.

papers.abstract_en: The clinicopathological significance and molecular basis of abnormal SMARCA2 expression in lung carcinoma remain poorly understood. We retrospectively analyzed 16 poorly differentiated lung carcinomas showing complete loss or diffuse marked reduction of SMARCA2 expression with preserved SMARCA4 and SMARCB1. The tumors exhibited a broad morphological spectrum and were classified as adenocarcinoma (n = 10), non-small cell carcinoma favoring adenocarcinoma (n = 2), squamous cell carcinoma (n = 3), or non-small cell carcinoma, not otherwise specified (n = 1). Clinical molecular testing revealed diverse molecular alterations, including KRAS, EGFR, ALK, TP53, PIK3CA, and CD274 abnormalities. Targeted SMARCA2 sequencing, performed in 11 cases, identified pathogenic or likely pathogenic alterations in four tumors without recurrent hotspot mutations. DNA methylation analysis of two CpG-rich regions, performed in nine cases, did not identify a consistent hypermethylation pattern within the analyzed regions. These findings demonstrate considerable morphological and molecular heterogeneity among lung carcinomas with abnormal SMARCA2 expression and preserved SMARCA4/SMARCB1. Recurrent SMARCA2 hotspot mutations and consistent hypermethylation of the analyzed CpG-rich regions were not identified, indicating that additional mechanisms may contribute to abnormal SMARCA2 expression.

papers.abstract_en: Although family members often occupy central positions in older adults' lay referral networks, most research assumes that they remain geographically nearby. Less is known about how transnational migration reshapes everyday health consultation when adult children live overseas. Drawing on lay referral network theory, this study examines how left-behind older adults in rural China seek health advice and support through local social relationships and transnational family relationships. We used an interpretive qualitative design and conducted 80 days of fieldwork in two transnational migrant-sending villages. Data were collected through participant observation and 35 semi-structured interviews with 22 older adults, and analyzed using reflexive thematic analysis. The findings indicate that minor health concerns were often first discussed with familiar peers in everyday village settings. Some participants minimized or delayed disclosing health concerns to avoid worrying their children and were more willing to discuss these concerns with local peers. Peers helped interpret medical instructions, assess symptoms, encourage healthcare-seeking, and provide practical assistance, although experience-based advice could also lead to delayed care. In addition, adult children abroad could arrange medical appointments and purchase health devices remotely, but some participants still needed nearby contacts to help them operate the devices or travel to appointments. Local peers were more involved in everyday health consultation, whereas children abroad were more involved in major medical decisions. Therefore, transnational separation changed how different relationships participate in health consultation.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Recovery capital is the availability of resources to support recovery. Prior research suggests a relationship between substances of choice (SOC) and recovery capital. This study explored the relationship between SOC and recovery capital among adolescents attending a recovery high school. METHODS: A secondary data analysis of data from the SEARS project was conducted. Participants (N = 624, agemean = 16.36) completed a modified Assessment of Recovery Capital (ARC) and responded to the question: "What is your drug of choice? (Please select all that apply)". Substances were grouped into type of SOC (alcohol, cannabis, opioids, stimulants, or other) and number of SOC (one, two, three or more, or "whatever is available"). RESULTS: A Kruskal-Wallis test to compare recovery capital across number of SOC groups indicated a significant difference, χ2(df = 3, N = 624) = 8.17, p = .043. Post hoc comparisons using Dunn's test identified that participants who selected "whatever is available" reported lower recovery capital than participants who preferred one SOC, p adjusted  = 0.022. There were no significant differences in recovery capital across type of SOC. DISCUSSION: The current study identified a relationship between number of SOC and recovery capital, suggesting those who prefer "whatever is available" may benefit from additional support. More work is needed to assess the utility and implications of SOC among adolescents in recovery. Researchers who ask participants about SOC may consider allowing participants to select multiple substances and including an option for "whatever is available" to better capture use preferences.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Nurturing care involves creating a stable, supportive environment by caregivers that promotes health, protection and developmentally stimulating interactions. There is a paucity of evidence regarding caregivers’ practices on caregiving and child-rearing and support for early learning opportunities in India. This study was conducted to assess the practices among caregivers of children (0–3 years) in all domains of Nurturing Care for Early Childhood Development (NC-ECD). METHODS: This cross-sectional study included primary caregivers of 610 children aged 0–3 years with a birth weight of more than 2500 g. These children included those brought to a medical college affiliated hospital for routine vaccinations and those being discharged from the hospital following an acute illness without any residual health effects. Primary caregivers were interviewed individually with a predesigned proforma pertaining to their practices in five domains of nurturing care ie good health, adequate nutrition, safety and security, responsive caregiving and opportunities for early learning. Caregivers’ responses were categorised as ‘always’, ‘sometimes’ and ‘never’. Overall, ‘appropriate’ practices were defined when >85% of responses were ‘always’. RESULTS: Most caregivers (n=370 (60%)) belonged to urban middle-class families, with 475 (78%) being part of nuclear families. The mother was the primary caregiver for 580 (95%) children. Median (IQR) age of enrolled children was 13 (5, 24) months, 348 (57%) were boys. Appropriate nurturing care practices were followed by 316 (51.8%) for safety and security, 183 (30%) for adequate nutrition, 26 (4.3%) for good health, 17 (2.8%) for responsive caregiving and 14 (2.3%) for early learning opportunities. CONCLUSIONS: Practices of caregivers on nurturing care for early child development were unsatisfactory in all the five domains, especially in domains of early learning opportunities, responsive caregiving and good health. Empowering the caregivers in nurturing care through existing health services needs to be prioritised.

papers.abstract_en: Sleep disruption in obstructive sleep apnea syndrome is characterized by frequent microarousals and reduced sleep depth, yet the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we show that intermittent hypercapnic air (HA) induces time-locked microarousals, fragments sleep, reduces non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep depth, and diminishes rapid eye movement (REM) sleep. HA exposure activates glutamatergic neurons in the nucleus tract solitary (NTSVglut2), and their optogenetic or chemogenetic activation is sufficient to trigger arousal and impair sleep. Projection-specific activation reveals that NTSVglut2 projections to the paraventricular nucleus (PVN), parabrachial nucleus (PB), paraventricular thalamus, and locus coeruleus (LC) promote arousal, whereas projections to the PB and LC additionally reduce NREM sleep depth. Inhibition of NTSVglut2 projection to the PVN significantly postpones HA-induced arousal. NTSVglut2 terminals monosynaptically activate corticotropin-releasing hormone neurons in the PVN (PVNCRH), and inhibition of PVNCRH neurons or knockdown of Slc17a6 (encoding Vglut2), but not Crh, delays hypercapnia-induced arousal. These findings identify neural circuits underlying hypercapnia-induced microarousal and reduced sleep depth.

papers.abstract_en: Flexible wearable sensors are increasingly used for long-duration monitoring of body-state information, but they can degrade silently during operation while continuing to output physiologically plausible signals, making it difficult to determine whether an incoming measurement remains trustworthy. Here, we report a self-prognostic electronic skin platform that couples multimodal body-state sensing with autonomous sensor-health assessment. The device monolithically co-integrates piezoelectric and triboelectric transduction by origami folding into an ultrathin, six-channel wrist-mounted array (∼0.1 mm, <1 g), so that a single mechanoelectrical stream simultaneously encodes cardiovascular pulsation, wrist activity, and the device's own degradation state. A two-stage self-diagnostic framework uses an autoencoder-CUSUM pipeline to establish device-specific failure labels from degradation trajectories, followed by an LSTM-Transformer model for remaining useful lifetime prediction. Across a twenty-device cohort with a nearly sevenfold variation in lifetime, the model predicts remaining useful lifetime across the cohort's degradation trajectories with R2 = 0.95 and captures uncertainty that increases as degradation becomes more severe. In single-participant daily-use proof-of-concept testing, the system estimates physiological parameters and sensor remaining lifetime from the same stream. The predicted lifetime of a newly fabricated device remained near 100% during a representative 1.5 h segment and declined modestly to 97.2% over approximately 12 h of wear distributed across multiple days; this single-device demonstration illustrates the operation of the diagnostic channel during daily use rather than validated cross-device predictive accuracy. These results establish reliability-aware wearable sensing, in which each body-state measurement is interpreted together with the operational health of the sensor itself, with potential value for long-duration applications such as health monitoring and embodied intelligence.

papers.abstract_en: Tissue mechanical adaptation is fundamental to organ development, regeneration, and disease, yet the cellular mechanisms that regulate tissue mechanical adaptation remain poorly understood. Here, we show that mesothelial cells are key regulators of lung mechanical adaptation. Following pneumonectomy, elevated stretch activates YAP (yes-associated protein 1) and induces a transient fibroblast-like mesothelial cell state (F-LMC) characterized by reduced mesothelial identity, increased fibroblast features, and extracellular matrix remodeling at the pleural surface. Yap deletion suppresses F-LMC formation, resulting in lung overinflation and defective regeneration following pneumonectomy. By contrast, in fibrotic lungs, this mesothelial remodeling program is aberrantly activated and restricts lung inflation. Inhibition of this maladaptive response prevents the decline in lung capacity following bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis. Collectively, our findings redefine the mesothelium as a mechanosensitive regulator of organ-scale mechanical adaptation and reveal how pleural surface remodeling controls tissue mechanics during regeneration and disease.

papers.title_en: Assessment of Immune and Proteomic Markers in Exhaled Breath Condensate: A Feasibility Study.
papers.authors: De Ryck E, Verscheure E, Schlünssen V, Würtz AML, Stierum R, Carpentier S, Ronsmans S, Pronk A et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department Public Health and Primary Care, Centre for Environment and Health, KU Leuven, Leuven 3000, Belgium.
papers.results: α-淀粉酶活性在EBC中较唾液低近10,000倍；EBC标志物在≥50%样本中可定量，除IL-12p70和血栓素B2外；EBC蛋白组学最多鉴定209种蛋白；跨基质相关性常较低。
papers.authors_conclusion: EBC是有前景的无创呼吸生物标志物发现方法，并证明在EBC中检测免疫和蛋白组标志物的实际可行性；EBC蛋白组可在单份EBC样本上生成。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：样本量、重复采样一致性、缺失率及统计检验均未报告；健康人群结果不能外推至疾病人群；“最多209种蛋白”为上限而非典型产量；“≥50%可定量”提示近半数样本仍低于定量限；跨基质相关性低但未给出相关系数或显著性。

papers.reason: 为EBC作为非侵入性呼吸生物标志物基质提供方法学可行性基线；影响后续胸科呼吸疾病生物标志物研究的样本基质选择与检测可行性判断，但不直接改变临床决策。
papers.abstract_en: Exhaled breath condensate (EBC) is a promising matrix for biomarker characterization that reflects the condition of the respiratory system. We assessed the practical feasibility of marker characterization in EBC, including quantification, comparison with plasma and saliva levels, and repeated sampling after six months, focusing on immune markers and proteomics. We measured several immune markers twice, six months apart, in EBC, saliva, and plasma, including cytokines and matrix metalloproteinases, and untargeted proteomics in EBC. α-Amylase activity was almost 10,000-fold lower in EBC than in saliva, suggesting at most limited saliva contamination during EBC collection. Generally, chemokine and eicosanoid levels were lower and more often below the limit of quantification in EBC versus plasma and saliva. Participants were healthy; still, EBC markers could be quantified in ≥50% of samples, except interleukin 12p70 and thromboxane B2. Correlations across matrices were often low, supporting EBC's matrix-specific properties. EBC proteomic analysis identified up to 209 proteins, several related to lung function. This study highlights EBC as a promising non-invasive method for respiratory biomarker discovery and demonstrates the practical feasibility of detecting immune and proteomic markers in EBC. Additionally, we showed that the EBC proteome can be generated on single EBC samples.

papers.title_en: Mepolizumab reduces oral corticosteroid use across distinct severe asthma phenotypes: 2-year REALITI-A study.
papers.authors: Chaudhuri R, Liu MC, Chupp G, Heaney LG, Lee JK, Pilette C, Brusselle G, Oppenheimer J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Infection & Immunity, University of Glasgow and Gartnavel General Hospital, Glasgow, UK;.
papers.results: 822 例纳入，39% 基线使用 mOCS；2 年后 mOCS 与总 OCS 的中位剂量降幅在各亚组均为 70-100%；44-71% 的患者停用 mOCS；37-68% 的患者总 OCS 剂量为 0 mg；未报告各亚组的置信区间或 P 值
papers.authors_conclusion: 数据表明美泊利珠单抗在广泛重度哮喘人群中可有效减少真实世界的 OCS 使用，不论奥马珠单抗资格及基线血嗜酸性粒细胞计数、IgE、特应性状态与 FeNO 如何
papers.ai_note: 单臂自身前后对照，缺乏平行对照，剂量下降无法与自然病程、OCS 减量方案变更或回归中位数区分；为事后亚组分析，未给出各亚组的具体数值、95%CI 或交互作用检验，仅以 70-100%、44-71% 等区间呈现，削弱了“各表型一致有效”这一结论的统计学支撑；未报告 OCS 减量的同时哮喘控制/急性发作是否维持（ACQ-5 与急性发作虽列为终点但摘要未给出数值），存在选择性强调；摘要未说明缺失值处理与亚组样本量。

pico.p: REALITI-A 中因重度哮喘启动美泊利珠单抗的成人患者，共 822 例，基线时 39% 使用维持口服糖皮质激素（mOCS）
pico.ic: 干预：美泊利珠单抗（加用生物制剂）；对照：无平行对照组，采用自身基线前后比较；按既往奥马珠单抗使用/资格、血嗜酸性粒细胞计数（<300/≥300 cells/μL 及四级分类）、IgE、特应性状态、FeNO 分层

papers.reason: 为重度哮喘生物制剂（抗 IL-5）在真实世界中减少口服激素暴露提供 2 年单臂基线数据，可作为胸科/呼吸专科激素减量策略与生物制剂选择的参考背景，但因无对照、无统计学检验，仅能作为假设生成与对照基线，不能用于确立疗效因果。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Oral corticosteroids (OCS) remain widely used in the treatment of severe asthma despite their adverse effects. Add-on biologic therapy offers the potential for minimizing OCS exposure. OBJECTIVE: This post hoc analysis of REALITI-A assessed the effect of mepolizumab on OCS use among subgroups of patients with severe asthma based on allergic/omalizumab-eligible phenotype and type-2 biomarker status. METHODS: REALITI-A was a prospective 2-year observational study among adults initiating mepolizumab for severe asthma. Endpoints assessed at 2 years were: change from baseline in daily maintenance OCS (mOCS) and total OCS dose, the proportion of patients discontinuing mOCS, the proportion of patients with 0 mg/day daily mOCS and total OCS dose, Asthma Control Questionnaire-5 scores, and clinically significant exacerbations. Outcomes were stratified by prior omalizumab use, omalizumab eligibility, baseline blood eosinophil count (threshold [<300/≥300 cells/μL] and category [<150/≥150-<300/≥300-<500/≥500 cells/μL]), baseline immunoglobulin E (IgE; <60/≥60-<190/≥190-<550/≥550 KU/L), atopic status (yes/no/unknown) and baseline fractional exhaled nitric oxide (FeNO; <25/≥25-<50/≥50 parts per billion). RESULTS: Overall, 822 patients were included, with 39% receiving mOCS at baseline. For both mOCS and total OCS, median dose reductions after 2 years from baseline were 70-100% across all subgroups. Also, after 2 years, 44-71% of patients across subgroups had discontinued mOCS and 37-68% had 0 mg total OCS dose. CONCLUSION: These data highlight mepolizumab's effectiveness in reducing real-world OCS use across a broad range of patients with severe asthma, irrespective of omalizumab eligibility and baseline blood eosinophil count, IgE, atopic status, and FeNO.

papers.title_zh: 局部（鼻内/吸入）干扰素-β1a 治疗呼吸道病毒感染的系统评价：抗病毒活性证据一致，临床获益因人群而异、预防性疗效有限
papers.title_en: Local Delivery of Interferon-β1a for Respiratory Viral Infections: A Systematic Review.
papers.authors: Nayebhashemi M, Akhavan M, Foroohari A, Khayat S, Roshanzamir K, Shafaati M, Salehi M
papers.affiliation_highlight: CinnaGen Medical Biotechnology Research Center, Alborz University of Medical Sciences, Karaj, Iran.
papers.results: 24 项研究符合纳入标准，包括 12 项 RCT、7 项体外研究、1 项体内研究和 4 项专利报告；临床研究中显示抗病毒活性与免疫调节（如 ISG 上调、病毒载量下降）；临床获益在不同人群中不一致，在哮喘、COPD 和住院 COVID-19 患者中最为一致，其他试验的主要临床终点未显示显著改善；早期鼻病毒感染的预防性研究显示临床预防效力有限且不一致，尽管可检测到抗病毒活性；安全性总体耐受良好，不良事件以轻度、一过性为主
papers.authors_conclusion: 现有证据表明，鼻内或吸入 IFN-β 可增强抗病毒免疫，并在部分呼吸道病毒性疾病中（尤其抗病毒反应受损个体）提供临床获益；但对社区获得性上呼吸道感染的预防效力证据仍有限，需进一步研究确定最佳适应证、给药策略和目标人群
papers.ai_note: ①主要临床终点在多项试验中为阴性（摘要原文：other trials did not demonstrate significant improvements in their primary clinical outcomes），而摘要与结论以“抗病毒活性一致”“ISG 上调、病毒载量下降”等替代/机制学指标及哮喘、COPD、住院 COVID-19 的亚组人群作为获益支撑，存在以次要/替代终点替代主要终点的选择性强调倾向；②采用叙述性分层合成而非定量合并，全文未给出任何效应量、CI 或 P 值，无法判断获益幅度与精确度；③纳入专利与灰色文献（虽声明不作为疗效证据），仍可能影响“开发生态”叙述的完整性偏向；④人群、给药剂量与剂型高度异质，结论中“selected respiratory viral conditions”的界定依赖事后分层；⑤结论“provide clinical benefit”措辞强于所报告的主要终点结果，属乐观表述；⑥该主题与胸部肿瘤/胸外科无直接关联，对本领域临床判断的迁移价值有限

pico.p: 呼吸道病毒感染人群（覆盖预防、治疗及实验模型），共 24 项符合纳入标准的研究，其中 12 项为 RCT
pico.ic: 鼻内或吸入局部给药干扰素-β1a（IFN-β1a）；对照设置摘要未明确说明

papers.reason: 为宿主导向抗病毒（局部干扰素-β）这一策略提供证据图谱与对照基线：明确抗病毒活性/免疫调节这类替代终点不能等同于临床获益，可用于评估围手术期或免疫抑制患者呼吸道病毒预防性干预研究设计时的终点选择与人群限定；与胸外科/胸部肿瘤核心业务关联较弱，主要作为方法学与外推边界参照
papers.abstract_en: Respiratory viral infections represent a major global health burden, with impaired antiviral interferon responses contributing to disease progression in several respiratory conditions. This systematic review evaluated the efficacy, safety, and biological effects of locally delivered intranasal or inhaled interferon-β1a (IFN-β1a), a host-directed antiviral therapy, across prophylactic, therapeutic, and experimental models of respiratory viral infections. A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines by searching PubMed, Embase, Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar, patent databases, and ClinicalTrials.gov up to July 2025. Peer-reviewed clinical and experimental studies, as well as relevant patent records, were identified. Patent and grey-literature sources were examined to provide a comprehensive overview of the development of locally delivered IFN-β1a and to identify relevant technological approaches that might not be captured in conventional bibliographic databases; however, these records were not considered evidence of clinical efficacy or safety. Eligible clinical and experimental evidence included randomized controlled trials (RCTs), in vitro, and in vivo studies. Owing to substantial clinical and methodological heterogeneity, findings were synthesised using a structured narrative and stratified approach rather than quantitative pooling. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 for RCTs, ToxRTool for in vitro studies, and the SYRCLE tool for in vivo studies. Twenty-four studies met the inclusion criteria, including 12 RCTs, seven in vitro studies, one in vivo study, and four patent reports. Preclinical evidence consistently demonstrated antiviral and immunomodulatory activity, including reduced viral replication and induction of interferon-stimulated genes. Clinical studies demonstrated consistent antiviral activity and immune modulation (e.g., ISG upregulation, viral load reduction). However, clinically meaningful benefit varied across populations and was most consistent in asthma, COPD, and hospitalised COVID-19 patients, whereas other trials did not demonstrate significant improvements in their primary clinical outcomes. Early prophylactic studies in rhinovirus infection showed limited and inconsistent clinical preventive efficacy despite detectable antiviral activity. Pharmacokinetic studies supported effective airway delivery, while safety findings indicated generally favourable tolerability with predominantly mild, transient adverse events. Available evidence indicates that intranasal or inhaled IFN-β may enhance antiviral immunity and provide clinical benefit in selected respiratory viral conditions, particularly among individuals with impaired antiviral responses. However, evidence for prophylactic efficacy against community-acquired upper respiratory tract infections remains limited, and further studies are required to define optimal indications, dosing strategies, and target populations.

papers.title_en: Deciphering the Benefits and Risks of Single-Inhaler Triple Therapy in COPD.
papers.authors: Kopitovic I, Dimic-Janjic S, Stjepanovic M, Hromis S, Zvezdin B, Ilic MP, Kolarov V, Milic R et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Faculty of Medicine, University of Novi Sad, 21000 Novi Sad, Serbia.
papers.results: 三联治疗组中重度急性加重减少，报告率比约0.69–0.93；IMPACT与ETHOS的死亡信号受既往ICS使用及对照组ICS撤除影响而难以解释；观察性心血管结局因残余混杂、治疗选择、暴露与结局错分及基线疾病严重度差异而不确定
papers.authors_conclusion: 与MITT相比，SITT的主要优势是治疗更简单以及依从性与持续性可能改善，而非药理作用更强；治疗决策应综合考虑急性加重史、重复血嗜酸粒细胞计数、肺炎风险、心血管疾病、既往ICS暴露与反应、吸入技术、装置适用性和患者偏好；需要在有记录证实无既往ICS使用的人群中开展试验并设计良好的目标试验模拟，以确定所观察到的死亡与心血管关联是否具因果性
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述无系统检索策略、纳排流程与偏倚风险评估，未作定量合并，仅给出约0.69–0.93的率比区间而无CI，属证据概述而非可验证的效应估计；文献纳入时间标注为2015至2026年，含尚未发表的未来时段，检索时点与更新机制信息不足；对死亡信号以“临床重要但难解释”表述，未量化其不确定性；整体属述评性总结，不能替代针对具体亚组的效应量证据

papers.reason: 为COPD三联吸入治疗在急性加重、死亡与心血管安全性之间的获益-风险权衡提供证据分层框架，并明确指出现有死亡获益证据受既往ICS暴露干扰，可用于指导吸入治疗降阶/升级与ICS撤除的临床决策边界，同时提示需在无既往ICS使用人群中重新验证
papers.abstract_en: Single-inhaler triple therapy (SITT) combines an inhaled corticosteroid (ICS; for example, fluticasone furoate, budesonide, or beclometasone dipropionate), a long-acting β2-agonist (LABA; for example, vilanterol or formoterol fumarate), and a long-acting muscarinic antagonist (LAMA; for example, umeclidinium or glycopyrronium bromide) in one device. Triple pharmacological therapy reduces exacerbations in selected patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), but its effects on mortality and cardiovascular outcomes remain uncertain. This structured narrative review summarizes randomized trials, observational comparative-effectiveness studies, target trial emulations, systematic reviews, and health technology assessments published between 2015 and 2026. We grouped the evidence by comparator: LABA/LAMA, ICS/LABA, multiple-inhaler triple therapy (MITT), and ICS continuation versus withdrawal, because each comparison addresses a different clinical question. Pivotal trials and evidence syntheses consistently showed fewer moderate-to-severe exacerbations with triple therapy, with reported rate ratios of approximately 0.69-0.93. Mortality signals from IMPACT and ETHOS are clinically important, but previous ICS use and ICS withdrawal among participants assigned to ICS-free comparators make these findings difficult to interpret. Observational cardiovascular findings are also uncertain because residual confounding, treatment selection, exposure misclassification, outcome misclassification, and differences in baseline disease severity limit causal interpretation. Compared with MITT, the main advantages of SITT are simpler treatment and possible improvements in adherence and persistence, not greater pharmacological potency. Treatment decisions should consider exacerbation history, repeated blood eosinophil counts, pneumonia risk, cardiovascular disease, previous ICS exposure and response, inhaler technique, device suitability, and patient preference. Trials in patients with documented absence of previous ICS use and well-designed target trial emulations are needed to determine whether the observed mortality and cardiovascular associations are causal.

papers.abstract_en: Dimensionality reduction and clustering are instrumental to single-cell and spatial genomics data analysis. Here we show that existing methods tend to fit oversampled classes and miss more unique signals and patterns, such as rare cell types and states. We find that the problem in such cases is not primarily data scarcity per se, but the model equating abundance with importance. Addressing this, we present "Distributionally Robust and latent Group-AwarE consensus Machine learning" or DR-GEM, a self-supervised meta-algorithm that uses the reconstruction error to reorient the model attention to patterns it initially missed and applies balanced consensus learning to increase robustness and filter low-quality data. We apply DR-GEM to synthetic and real-world single-cell, spatial transcriptomics, and Perturb-seq datasets and demonstrate that it outperforms existing methods in obtaining reliable embeddings, recovering rare cell types, filtering noise, mitigating cell-level and patient-level underrepresentation, and uncovering held-out genetic and spatial features. We thus surface and address an underappreciated problem and present a self-supervised framework to help support AI-based and data-driven discoveries.

papers.authors: Pragalos AA, Pacciarini F, Jin H, Hopkins T, Zhang Y, Bugarini R, Liu X, Sullivan BM et al.

papers.results: N=212；ARCT-2304剂量为1.5、5、12 mcg；接种程序为4周或8周；第二剂后28天评估HA抑制和NA酶联凝集素试验免疫原性；8周间隔组在第二剂后6–7个月中和抗体和抗NA抗体仍显著升高；T细胞反应在第29天达峰。摘要未报告具体抗体滴度、AE发生率或P值/CI。

papers.reason: 该研究评估大流行H5N1自扩增mRNA疫苗的剂量与接种间隔，对流感大流行准备和疫苗平台选择有参考价值，但与胸外科/胸部肿瘤日常临床判断关联有限。
papers.abstract_en: Avian influenza poses a persistent pandemic threat, yet traditional vaccines face production delays. Self-amplifying mRNA (sa-mRNA) technology offers potential advantages, including rapid development, dose sparing, and enhanced, durable immunity. We evaluated ARCT-2304, a bicistronic sa-mRNA vaccine encoding H5N1 hemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA), in a Phase 1 randomized, observer-blind trial (NCT06602531). Healthy adults (N = 212) received two doses of ARCT-2304 (1.5, 5, or 12 mcg) or control/placebo on a 4- or 8-week schedule. Primary outcomes evaluated safety and reactogenicity (solicited/unsolicited/serious adverse events [AEs]) and immunogenicity (HA inhibition and NA enzyme-linked lectin assays 28 days post-second dose). Immunogenicity results were benchmarked using serum from a prior study supporting licensure of an H5N1 vaccine. ARCT-2304 was well-tolerated, displaying mostly mild-to-moderate, transient, dose-dependent solicited AEs, with no safety concerns identified. Two doses elicited robust HA and NA humoral responses. An 8-week interval yielded higher magnitude and greater durability than a 4-week schedule, with neutralizing and anti-NA antibodies remaining significantly elevated 6-7 months post-second dose. ARCT-2304 also induced dose-dependent, Th1-polarized T-cell responses peaking at Day 29. These findings support advancing sa-mRNA platforms for pandemic influenza preparedness.

papers.title_zh: 晚期COPD患者肺康复的行为适应与应答：应对策略与6分钟步行改善相关，常规生理与免疫标志物未能区分应答（附36例探索性心理支持预试验）
papers.title_en: Behavioral Adaptation and Response to Pulmonary Rehabilitation in Older Patients with Advanced COPD: Beyond Clinical and Immune Biomarkers.
papers.authors: Russo P, Proietti S, Vitiello L, Pace S, Tomino C, Felzani G, Prinzi G, Bonassi S et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Human Sciences and Promotion of the Quality of Life, San Raffaele University, Via di Val Cannuta 247, 0016…
papers.results: 良好应答者计划（planning）应对评分高于无应答者（7.10 ± 1.35 vs. 5.05 ± 1.93，p < 0.001）；主动应对与计划评分越高，6MWD改善越大；自我分心在不同应答组间亦有差异；探索性中介分析中计划是唯一具统计学显著间接效应的应对策略，估计中介比例约26.5%（置信区间宽，提示不确定性大）；常规生理指标、生活方式特征及免疫标志物（TTV病毒血症、循环T细胞亚群）均未能显著区分康复应答组；计划与主动应对在两个性别中均与应答相关；IMPROVE预试验（n=36）6个月时接受心理支持者康复获益维持更好，同时心理幸福感、生活质量及部分应对策略改善（摘要未报告具体数值）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 这些结果为应对相关特征可能具有可修饰性提供了初步证据；但IMPROVE为独立的探索性干预研究，并非用于验证观察性发现。应对策略评估可补充临床与功能评价，有助于识别可从个体化心理支持中获益的患者；其临床效用与针对性干预的有效性尚需更大样本前瞻性研究证实。
papers.ai_note: 观察性关联与随后独立的探索性RCT在摘要中并置叙述，易被读作同一因果链，但作者已声明IMPROVE非验证性设计。主要功能终点仅以“相关/组间差异”描述，未报告6MWD变化的效应量与置信区间，应答者/无应答者的切点亦未交代。中介分析为探索性，中介比例26.5%伴宽置信区间，作者自承不确定性大；同时评估多种应对策略，未见多重比较校正说明。生物标志物（TTV、T细胞亚群）阴性结果被置于次要位置，构成本文较可靠的阴性证据，但样本量与效能未报告。IMPROVE为n=36的探索性研究，摘要无任何数值，无法评估其效应大小。

pico.p: 晚期COPD（GOLD III–IV）完成3周多学科肺康复项目的患者102例；另设独立预试验IMPROVE 36例
pico.ic: 观察部分无干预，按6MWD改善程度分组比较临床、功能、心理、生活方式与免疫特征（含Brief COPE应对策略、TTV病毒血症、循环T细胞亚群）；IMPROVE为结构化心理支持干预与对照比较（摘要未述对照与干预细节）

papers.reason: 为肺康复应答异质性提供行为学（应对策略）解释线索，并给出免疫/病毒学标志物无区分力的阴性对照信息；对胸部肿瘤领域仅间接参考（如围手术期预康复、呼吸康复依从性研究的行为学变量选择与中介设计），不能直接改变胸科临床决策。
papers.abstract_en: Patients with advanced chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) respond differently to pulmonary rehabilitation (PR), and respiratory impairment alone might not fully explain this variability. Behavioral adaptation may contribute to differences in rehabilitation response. We studied 102 patients with advanced COPD (GOLD III-IV) who completed a 3-week multidisciplinary PR program. Functional response was assessed by change in six-minute walking distance (6MWD). Clinical, functional, psychological, lifestyle, and immune characteristics were evaluated, including coping strategies measured with the Brief COPE, Torque Teno virus (TTV) viremia, and circulating T-cell subsets. Exploratory mediation analyses examined whether coping strategies contributed to the association between age and rehabilitation response. Greater improvement in 6MWD was associated with higher active coping and planning scores, while self-distraction also differed across response groups. Planning scores were higher in good responders than in non-responders (7.10 ± 1.35 vs. 5.05 ± 1.93, respectively; p < 0.001). Planning was the only coping strategy showing a statistically significant indirect effect in the exploratory mediation analysis. The estimated proportion mediated was approximately 26.5%, although the wide confidence interval indicated substantial uncertainty. These findings should be interpreted cautiously given the observational design and the assessment of multiple coping strategies. Conventional physiological measures, lifestyle characteristics, and immune biomarkers-including TTV viremia and circulating T-cell subsets-did not significantly distinguish rehabilitation response groups. Planning and active coping were associated with response in both sexes. A separate pilot randomized study, IMPROVE (n = 36), was subsequently conducted to investigate whether structured psychological support could influence coping strategies and help maintain the benefits of PR. At six months, patients receiving psychological support showed better maintenance of rehabilitation benefits, alongside improvements in psychological well-being, quality of life, and selected coping strategies. These findings provide preliminary evidence that coping-related characteristics may be modifiable; however, IMPROVE was a separate exploratory intervention study and was not designed to validate the observational findings. Assessment of coping strategies may complement clinical and functional evaluation and help identify patients who could benefit from tailored psychological support. Their clinical utility and the effectiveness of targeted interventions require confirmation in larger prospective studies.

papers.title_zh: 机器学习预测ECMO患者死亡、并发症与感染风险的结构化叙述性综述：现有模型以单一结局和静态变量为主，尚缺ECMO支持期间继发感染的预测模型
papers.title_en: Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation (ECMO) Prediction of Mortality and Integrated Complication with Infection Risk Assessment by Machine Learning: Structured Narrative Review.
papers.authors: Birlik BA, Hamlaoui O, Tozan H, Layeb SB, Ait El Fqih M
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Medical Services and Techniques, Istinye University, Istanbul 34245, Türkiye.
papers.results: 共纳入25项研究，按四个领域分组：死亡预测；并发症预测（神经、出血、血栓）；ECMO需求与流程管理；出院后再入院。各领域中ML模型表现均优于传统风险评分。多数模型为单一结局模型，主要使用静态或ECMO上机前数据。未检索到可用于预测ECMO支持期间继发感染的ECMO专用机器学习模型。
papers.authors_conclusion: 当前证据提示ECMO风险预测正从传统评分方法转向机器学习预测方法；但仍存在关键缺失，包括未纳入动态生理数据、未纳入免疫学标志物、缺乏多结局预测方法，需克服这些局限才能构建临床可用的决策支持系统。ML模型在改善ECMO风险分层方面很有前景，应开展整合死亡、并发症、感染风险与实时临床数据的多结局预测模型研究，并可整合入常规ECMO实践、电子病历或ECMO监测系统，生成时间更新且可解释的风险预警，以支持早期干预、抗菌药物管理与资源规划。
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，未报告定量合并、未使用偏倚风险评估工具、未给出PRISMA式筛选流程计数与排除原因分布，检索式与纳排执行可重复性有限。“ML模型一致优于传统评分”为定性归纳，未提供效应量、置信区间或研究间异质性信息，无法判断优势幅度与稳健性。纳入标准表述含混（“未包含常规统计方法”作为排除条件语义不清），可能造成纳入偏倚。“无ECMO感染预测模型”属阴性检索结论，但未说明是否受检索词及数据库限制影响，存在漏检可能。文献覆盖至2025年8月，需注意与实际检索执行时间的时序一致性。

pico.ic: 基于机器学习/人工智能算法的ECMO结局预测模型；对照为传统风险评分或常规统计方法（排除非ECMO人群、无临床相关预测结局及社论/评论类文献）

papers.reason: 为ECMO风险预测的机器学习研究提供领域地图与明确空白点（感染预测缺失、静态变量为主、缺多结局模型），可作为单中心ML建模选题与对照基线设定的依据；对心胸外科围术期ECMO辅助患者的风险沟通与资源规划有间接参考价值，但不改变具体临床决策阈值。
papers.abstract_en: Background: Extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) is an extremely complex life-saving treatment that is performed on patients who are in severe cardiac and/or respiratory failure. Even with all the technological progress, ECMO is a procedure with high mortality and significant morbidity, making it important to predict the risks of ECMO in a timely and accurate manner. Objective: To offer a narrative review of the machine learning (ML) based risk prediction models currently used for ECMO, with particular focus on multi-outcome prediction-mortality, complications and infections. Methods: Structured narrative review of relevant literature was undertaken in PubMed, Web of Science, Scopus and IEEE Xplore from 2000 to August 2025. Eligible studies comprised machine-learning or artificial-intelligence algorithms to predict clinically important ECMO outcomes and in ECMO-supported patients. Studies that did not include conventional statistical methods, non-ECMO patient populations, or articles that presented editorials, commentaries, or articles lacking clinically relevant prediction outcomes were excluded. Titles and abstracts were screened; full text assessed for eligibility and extracted data organized using the CHARMS framework. Results: 25 studies were included, and these were divided into four areas, namely, mortality prediction, complication prediction (neurological, bleeding, thrombosis), requirement for ECMO and process management, and hospital readmission. In all these areas, ML models consistently showed better performance than traditional risk scores, picking up the high-dimensional interactions and nonlinear relationships. But the majority of current models are outcome-specific and use mostly static or pre-ECMO data. Of note, no potentially eligible ECMO-specific machine-learning model to predict incident secondary infection during ECMO support was found despite the impact of infection on outcomes, length of stay, antimicrobial usage, and health-care costs. Conclusions: The current evidence suggests that there is a shift in approach from traditional scoring methods to predictive approaches using ML. However, there are still key missing elements such as the lack of incorporation of dynamic physiological data, the lack of incorporation of immunological markers, and the lack of multi-outcome predictive approaches. These limitations need to be overcome to build clinically actionable decision-support systems. ML-based models are very promising in improving risk stratification in ECMO. Other studies should be conducted to create multi-outcome prediction models which incorporate mortality, complications, infection risk and real-time clinical data. These models could be integrated into routine ECMO practice, into electronic health records or ECMO monitoring systems, to generate time-updated and interpretable risk alerts to inform early intervention, antimicrobial stewardship, and resource planning.
